name: H5 — output moderation pass on displayed mentor replies (post-Gemini classifier replacement)
description:
[V2-GATES] H5 from the 2026-06-05 safety audit (docs/registers/llm-models/master.md:121): a final output-content check on the reply actually displayed to the learner. IMPORTANT SCOPE CORRECTION from surface read — most of the mechanism this item describes ALREADY EXISTS and is live in production, gated behind flags; the AC as originally captured ("design chosen and recorded: judge-capability reuse, provider moderation, or hybrid") reads as greenfield design work but is not — WI-1365 already built and shipped a synchronous, fail-closed enforcing gate on this exact rubric (apps/api/src/services/suitability-gate.ts, docstring: "Suitability-judge ENFORCING output gate for minors"). Confirmed live wiring: apps/api/src/services/session/session-exchange.ts:4980-5026 calls runSuitabilityEnforcement() LAST over the final candidate reply, fail-closed on a 'violation' verdict (with an over-blocking category allowlist, suitability-gate.ts:57-79), fail-OPEN with a structured Inngest escalation event on judge unavailability (emitSuitabilityJudgeUnavailableEvent, session-exchange.ts:5018-5026) AND on a block (emitSuitabilityBlockedEvent, session-exchange.ts:5008-5017) — i.e. the "fail-open with structured Inngest escalation" AC is already met for the covered population. The gate is inert unless JUDGE_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED is on (config.ts:241, default 'false') AND the learner is a minor: suitability-gate.ts:121,131,193 hard-codes "Adult (isMinor: false) -> pass, never judged" — adults get NO check at all, by deliberate prior design (the calibration-only rollout target minors first). This item's REAL remaining scope, grounded in code, is materially narrower than the original AC: (a) extend an output check to adult traffic (the register's H5 wording names "the learner" without minor-scopi

ng); (b) verify and document JUDGE_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED's actual current stg/prd value (the WI's own capture text asserts 'live in prd since cutover' — confirm this against Doppler, do not assume); (c) close out the master.md H5 register row once adult coverage lands. Do NOT re-design the mechanism from scratch — extend the existing runSuitabilityJudge/runSuitabilityEnforcement/suitability-gate.ts pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Output-check coverage is extended to non-minor (adult) traffic using the existing runSuitabilityJudge/suitability-gate.ts mechanism — design decision recorded for HOW adults are covered (synchronous full check matching the minor path vs async/sampled check, given latency-budget and live-call-cost tradeoffs at 100% adult volume); a hybrid (sync minor, async-sampled adult) is an acceptable resolution but must be an explicit, written decision, not a default.
- The existing fail-open-with-Inngest-escalation and fail-closed-on-violation behavior (suitability-gate.ts, session-exchange.ts:5008-5026) is preserved/extended for the new adult path — never a raw learner-facing error, no silent recovery.
- Latency budget for the adult path is documented and met (no perceptible stream delay on whatever path — sync or async — is chosen).
- JUDGE_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED's actual current stg and prd values are verified against Doppler (not assumed from prior capture text) and recorded in the completion evidence.
- Covered by eval-llm safety battery cases for the adult path specifically; a negative-path test proves a flagged adult-facing output is caught under the chosen mechanism.
- docs/registers/llm-models/master.md's H5 row (line ~121) is updated to closed with mechanism + date, citing the existing WI-1365 minor-path implementation plus this item's adult-path extension.
